title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleNative: 大崎さんと小森さん
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

title: Fuuto Tantei
titleNative: 風都探偵
synopsis: In the ecologically-minded city of Fuuto, mysterious devices resembling USB flash drives called Gaia Memories are used by criminals and other interested parties to become monsters called Dopants, committing crimes with the police force powerless to stop them. To make matters worse, the Gaia Memories carry a dangerous toxin that cause their users to go insane to the point where they could die from the life-threatening devices. After the death of his boss, the self-proclaimed hard-boiled detective Shoutarou Hidari works with the mysterious Philip to investigate crimes which involve Dopants. Using their own Gaia Memories, Shoutarou and Philip use the Double Driver belts to transform and combine into Kamen Rider Double to fight the Dopant menace and keep Fuuto safe. (Source: Kamen Rider W Wiki) Note: Fuuto Tantei is a manga adaptation and sequel of the 2009 drama TV series Kamen Rider W .

titleNative: 月とライカと吸血姫
synopsis: In an alternate version of the 1960s, two global superpowers have emerged after a savage war: the Zirnitra Union and the United Kingdom of Arnack. East and West are locked in a fierce race to send the first crewed flight into outer space, leading the Union to develop a secret agenda: the Nosferatu Project, which aims to use vampires as spaceflight test subjects. Similar to humans but feared and reviled, vampires are assumed to make the perfect "guinea pigs" for such a dangerous task. Lev Leps, a Union soldier and aspiring cosmonaut, is tasked with overseeing vampire Irina Luminesk aka N44, who has been chosen for the operation–and he can't quite detach his feelings from the vampire girl as planned. Faced with pressure and peril, will either of them manage to fly into the cosmos? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

title: A Witch's Life in Mongol
titleNative: 天幕のジャードゥーガル
synonyms: Una bruja en el imperio mongol
synopsis: In the harem of the Khan, wisdom is beauty. The time: the thirteenth century. The place: Yeke Mongol Ulus, the greatest empire the world has ever known. The woman: Fatima, hailing from Persia, where medical technique and scientific knowledge have been perfected beyond all precedent. Fatima's desire for a stage where she can put all her knowledge to work has brought her to the palace of the Mongols, where she falls under the wing of Töregene, the sixth wife of Ögedei, the second Great Khan—a mighty woman with complicated feelings about the direction of the empire. These two women are the axle upon which the politics of the palace, and soon the very world, will turn... (Source: Yen Press) Notes: - Ranked 1st in the Women's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023 guidebook. - Ranked 5th in the 16th Manga Taisho Awards in 2023. - Ranked 5th in the 17th Manga Taisho Awards in 2024. - Winner of the Overseas Work Award at the 2024 Bucheon International Comics Festival. - Nominated for the Best New Manga category at the 2025 American Manga Awards. - Winner of the Grand Prize in the Comic Division at the 55th Japan Cartoonists Association Awards in 2026.

synopsis: College student Tendo Souma had two favorite "oshi," he popular Vtuber Henrietta and the idol voice-actress Yasumi Hiyori. His typical "oshi activity" changes dramatically when his "oshi" moves into the apartment next door! And it seems like she's not alone!? Souma is excited about his dream come true at first, but then he is confronted with an "unfortunate reality." (Source: Comic Gardo, translated)

title: Gakusha to Kariudo
titleNative: 学者と狩人
synopsis: Long ago, the gods, having triumphed over the demons, entrusted the earth to humankind. Meanwhile, the defeated demons unleashed magical beasts upon the earth in an attempt to reclaim the “Land of Demons.” The “Land of Demons”—known to the people as Teikokushi (Imperial Territory) Lutrant—was suddenly invaded by a gigantic magical beast known as the Chigei or Bahmat. Having suffered immense damage from a catastrophe that occurred over a decade ago, humanity spent its days fighting against the threat of these magical beasts—. As the title suggests, the protagonists of this story are a duo consisting of a scholar and a hunter. Ritsel, the scholar, studies the ecology of the monsters to determine how best to deal with the threat they pose. On the other hand, Vizal, the hunter, has only one goal: to eliminate the monsters that stand before him. This mismatched duo, whose thoughts and actions are polar opposites, appears to operate independently, without belonging to any organization. (Source: Aokishi, translated)
